Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

out of place adjective

also if it is not out of place, inappropriate, unsuitable, not out of place to

classical

Nep. Milt. 6.1: nōn aliēnum vidētur, quāle praemium Miltiadī sit tribūtum, docēre (Lewis & Short)
Cic. de Or. 2.9: hoc aliēnum est (Lewis & Short s.v. aliquī)
Traupman 105: if it is not out of place, nisi aliēnum est

aliēnus, aliēna, aliēnum

adjective; with ab and the ablative, or the dative; nōn aliēnum est (+ inf.), it is not out of place to · Declension on Wiktionary

out of place, unsuitable (to something)

What belongs to someone else is out of place here: aliēnum est, it does not fit. An aside asking leave to say something: nisi aliēnum est, if it is not out of place.

Other words

  • ineptus, inepta, ineptum — unsuitable, out of place

    also used · classical · Traupman 154 · Declension on Wiktionary

    Lewis & Short: in-aptus, “unsuitable, impertinent”; also silly.
